title: Payment card family
slide_intent: Compare identity across product tiers because differentiation must coexist with a recognizable payment brand.
strategic_value: A shared mark position and recurring circular detail can connect cards with different material impressions.
demonstration: Four cards in a two-by-two arrangement show World Elite, World, Platinum and Mastercard treatments.
practical_value: Compare the colored and metallic symbol treatments within this historical card family.

content_islands.name: Card grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange four rounded cards in two rows on a pale field.

content_islands.name: Product details
content_islands.spec: Retain each tier name, chip, account details and circular linework.

content_islands.name: Identity marks
content_islands.spec: Keep each small signature at the lower right, including the monochrome World Elite treatment.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork places the identity on four named payment cards.
